get.description: Discovery surface for content-driven CDS. Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List condition slugs and titles

get.description: Returns presentation, red flags, diagnostics, ordered management steps, and source citations. No patient data is required or accepted at this endpoint.
get.summary: Get structured clinical guidance for a condition

get.description: Filters: domain (e.g. emergency, paediatrics), q (free text over slug/title/CPT). Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List procedures

get.description: Returns indications, contraindications, equipment, consent notes, ordered steps with safety checks, red flags, post-procedure care, complications and management, and citations.
get.summary: Get structured procedural guidance by slug

get.description: Returns summaries (no full body). Each policy is a clinical SOP or external standard (JCI, ISO, WHO, NICE, company). Policies are integrator-scoped and used by the agentic engine to align recommendations.
get.summary: List uploaded policies / standards for the current integrator

post.description: Accepts either an array of structured `sections` ({title?, body}) or a single `text` body. Source identifies the standard family (JCI, ISO, WHO, NICE, company, other). The body must contain ONLY the integrator's own policy text — never patient identifiers or clinical data.

get.summary: Get a single policy with its sections

get.description: Open catalogue of validated scores (CHA2DS2-VASc, Wells, NEWS2, GCS, CURB-65, etc.). Filters: domain, q (free text over slug/title/abbreviation). Returns summaries; fetch full definition by slug.
get.summary: List clinical scoring tools

get.description: Returns purpose, scored items with points, scoring method, interpretation bands with suggested actions, and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a clinical score definition by slug

get.description: Open CPIC-style catalogue (HLA-B*57:01-abacavir, TPMT/NUDT15-thiopurines, CYP2C19-clopidogrel, DPYD-fluoropyrimidines, G6PD-oxidants, etc.). Filters: gene, drug, q. Returns summaries; fetch full phenotype guidance by slug.
get.summary: List pharmacogenomic gene-drug guidance

get.description: Returns the keyed variant, clinical summary, phenotype-based implications and recommendations (with strength), testing guidance and citations. Reference content only — no patient genotype or identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a gene-drug pharmacogenomic guideline by slug

get.description: Open catalogue of condition-based contraindications and cautions (e.g. NSAID in CKD, metformin in AKI, beta-blocker in asthma). Filters: drug (slug or name), condition (slug or name), severity (contraindicated|caution), q. Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List drug-disease / drug-condition interactions

get.description: Returns the drug/class, condition, severity, mechanism, recommendation and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a drug-disease interaction by slug

get.description: Open routine immunization schedule (BCG, HepB, pentavalent, OPV/IPV, PCV, rotavirus, measles/MR, HPV, Td, yellow fever, MenA, etc.). Filters: disease, q. Returns summaries; fetch full dose schedule by slug.
get.summary: List WHO EPI immunization schedule entries

get.description: Returns target diseases, dose timings and routes, target population, catch-up guidance, notes and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an immunization schedule entry by slug

get.description: Open catalogue of drug allergy cross-reactivity, including common myths to dispel (e.g. penicillin-cephalosporin, sulfonamide antibiotic vs diuretics, contrast vs shellfish). Filters: drug (slug or name), risk (high|moderate|low|negligible), q. Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List drug allergy cross-reactivity entries

get.description: Returns the allergen, what it does (or does not) cross-react with, the risk level, mechanism, recommendation, related drug slugs and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an allergy cross-reactivity entry by slug

get.description: Open reference of WHO IHR and commonly nationally-notifiable diseases with reporting urgency. Filters: level (ihr-always|ihr-assess|national-immediate|national-routine), q. National statutory lists vary — this is guidance, not the local legal list. Returns summaries; fetch detail by slug.
get.summary: List notifiable diseases (public-health reporting reference)

get.description: Returns the disease, notification level, reporting timeframe, linked condition slug, notes and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a notifiable-disease entry by slug

get.description: Open catalogue of typical adult reference intervals (UCUM units) for labs and vital signs. Filters: category (electrolytes, renal, liver, haematology, vital-signs, etc.), q. Local laboratory/method-specific ranges always take precedence. Returns summaries; fetch full range by slug.
get.summary: List laboratory and vital-sign reference ranges

get.description: Returns the analyte, specimen, low/high bounds, UCUM unit, sex applicability, notes and source caveat. Reference content only — no patient identity or result is processed.
get.summary: Get a reference range by slug

get.description: Open antidote reference (paracetamol->NAC, opioid->naloxone, organophosphate->atropine/pralidoxime, iron->desferrioxamine, digoxin->Fab, methanol->fomepizole, beta-blocker->glucagon, CCB->calcium, LAST->lipid emulsion, cyanide->hydroxocobalamin, etc.). Filters: poison, antidote (name or drug slug), q. Returns summaries; fetch mechanism and dosing by slug.
get.summary: List toxicology antidotes (poison -> antidote)

get.description: Returns the poison, antidote (with drug slug), mechanism, dosing guidance, linked poisoning condition and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an antidote entry by slug

info.title: VedaMD API
info.description: Open-source, stateless Clinical Decision Support API. CDS Hooks + REST/JSON. VedaMD never stores patient data — records remain with your EMR.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA-256 fingerprint of the secret. Used for safe display.

name.description: Human-readable label for this key — shown in the dashboard.

scopes.description: Capability scopes granted to this key. Must contain at least one.

environment.description: Which environment this key applies to. Sandbox keys are isolated from prod.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA-256 fingerprint of the secret. Used for safe display.

secret.description: The raw bearer secret. Shown EXACTLY ONCE — copy it now. Use it as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.

hook.description: CDS Hook to evaluate against (e.g. medication-prescribe, patient-view).

question.description: Free-text clinical question for the agentic reasoner.
question.example: Is metformin safe to start in this patient?

mode.description: Pipeline mode. `deterministic` skips LLM; `agentic` requires an LLM provider; `auto` runs LLM if configured, else degrades to deterministic.

minConfidence.description: Drop agentic cards with confidence below this threshold (0..1).

medications.description: Active medications by free-text name, RxNorm/ATC code, or VedaMD slug. Fuzzy-matched.

diagnoses.description: Active diagnoses by name, ICD-10/11, or slug.

signals.description: Free-form additional signals (vitals, observations) passed straight through.

hook.description: CDS Hook to evaluate against (e.g. medication-prescribe, patient-view).

mode.description: Pipeline mode. `deterministic` skips LLM; `agentic` requires an LLM provider; `auto` runs LLM if configured, else degrades to deterministic.

minConfidence.description: Drop agentic cards with confidence below this threshold (0..1).

medications.description: Active medications by free-text name, RxNorm/ATC code, or VedaMD slug. Fuzzy-matched.

id.description: Caller-supplied opaque id to correlate the result (e.g. encounter id). Never logged.

items.description: Up to 100 anonymous clinical contexts. Each is evaluated independently.

resource.description: FHIR R4 Bundle or single resource (Patient, MedicationRequest, Observation, Condition). Parsed by the FHIR adapter.

connectionId.description: Server-side configured connection id (never a raw connection string from the client).

queryId.description: Server-side named query template id (prevents arbitrary SQL injection).

params.description: Bound parameters for the named query.
